name: Permafrost

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.desc: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.desc: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Reaper's Tithe
perks.desc: Multiple simultaneous final blows queue up a stacking damage buff. Timer starts on next weapon fire; final blows extend this timer.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Dawning Surprise
perks.desc: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.desc:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for controlling groups of Minor adds in general at-level or better content, particularly on grenade builds. Permafrost is a wave frame GL which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic having been power crept by aerial denial frames, so this is more to think about keeping in case there's a future rebalancing. The stats are in-band by comparison with its peers - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2922964484 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Looks for a barrel perk that helps Handling - Velocity's nice, but you'll be shooting at your feet most of the time. Try not to hurt the Blast Radius, as that affects the width and height of the wave. For the magazine perk just High-Velocity Rounds. If you're running a grenade build, in the first trait perk column Demolitionist generates chunk grenade ability energy on kills and an instant magazine refill on grenade use, or Blast Distributor stacks up to ×5 to provide +10 to your Grenade attribute (+13 when enhanced) per stack on dealing explosive damage - to a total of +50 (+65 enhanced) - for 5s refreshable on further explosive damage so you can invest stat points into other armour attributes. In the second column, Crystalline Corpsebloom procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced) - these are weapon-generated entities so can generate grenade energy when shattered for AoE damage by a weapon with the Demolitionist perk. If you're interested, Permafrost is a permanently frozen layer on or under Earth's surface. For the Origin Trait, Dawning Surprise has a hidden counter - 6 red bar kills (5 enhanced) or 2 orange/yellow bars will fill this to generate a pickup which last 10s that grants 10% energy to melee, grenade and super, +22 HP and start regeneration, so can be very useful or Field Test provides steady boosts to Range, Stability, Handling and Reload Speed on hits and kills, lasting until you die. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

A great looking add clear and utility GL, held back by the fact that area denial frames exist and invalidate this thing's entire purpose. Honestly, this still ticks a lot of boxes for me personally, so I'll be going for one in the hopes that the archetype can make a comeback." Recommended MW: Reload, Blast Radius.
